BUSINESS STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Mombasa
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

2. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.

3. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   C. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   D. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.

4. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

5. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   C. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   D. Treat Marketing as rumours only.

7. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

9. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Destroying road signs
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Obeying laws and caring for public property

10. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   B. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   D. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   D. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.

13. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   D. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.

14. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.

15. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   C. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.
   D. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Inflation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain National Income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Networking in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Entrepreneurship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
